blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Recruitment is the process of finding new people to join the company. It is a journey, step by step. The goal is simple: find the right person for the right role.

First, HR writes a job description. Then, they post the job online. People send their CVs and apply. The best candidates come for an interview.

Finally, one person gets the offer. That person becomes a new employee. Good recruitment takes time and care.

items.q: What is recruitment?
options: A meeting with the whole team
A new office in another city
The process of finding new people to join the company
items.why: "Recruitment is the process of finding new people to join the company."

items.q: What does HR write first?
items.why: "First, HR writes a job description."

items.q: What do people send when they apply?
items.why: "People send their CVs and apply."

items.q: The text says recruitment is "a journey, step by step." This suggests that recruitment…
options: has an order and takes several stages
items.why: Inferência: "journey, step by step" mostra que há etapas em ordem — não é tudo de uma vez.

items.q: Which idea would the author most likely AGREE with?
options: Any person is fine for any role
Choosing the right person is worth the time
Interviews are a waste of time
items.why: Inferência: "find the right person" e "takes time and care" mostram que escolher bem vale o tempo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver, o recrutador, no trabalho. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, my name is Oliver. I am a recruiter here. Today is a busy day for me.

Right now I am reading CVs for a new finance role. We have many candidates this time. I am looking for the right person for the team.

This morning I am also preparing three interviews. The first candidate is coming at two o'clock. I am reading her CV again, because I want to ask good questions.

The job description is clear. We need someone with numbers and with good English. Two candidates look very strong on paper, but the interview is important. A CV tells me part of the story, not all of it.

Later today, I am writing my notes for my manager. Tomorrow we choose who gets the offer. It is a big step for the person and for the company. I always take my time here, because finding the right person is not easy.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Oliver's job?
items.why: "I am a recruiter here."

items.q: What is Oliver doing right now?
options: Reading CVs for a new finance role
items.why: "Right now I am reading CVs for a new finance role."

items.q: When is the first candidate coming?
items.why: "The first candidate is coming at two o'clock."

items.q: Oliver says "a CV tells me part of the story, not all of it." This suggests that…
options: the interview still matters a lot
the candidates are all the same
items.why: Inferência: se o CV mostra só parte, a entrevista completa a informação — por isso importa.

items.q: Why does Oliver take his time?
options: Because finding the right person is not easy
Because he does not like the job
items.why: Inferência: "I always take my time… because finding the right person is not easy."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We have ten candidates for the job." A candidate is…
options: a person who wants the job
items.why: Candidate = candidato(a): a pessoa que quer a vaga.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please send your ___ so we can see your work experience."
items.why: CV / résumé = currículo, onde estão a experiência e a formação.

items.q: "She got the offer and started on Monday." An offer is…
options: a proposal to give someone the job
items.why: Offer = proposta: o convite formal para ocupar a vaga.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is one open ___ in the finance team, so we need one new person."
items.why: Vacancy = vaga: a posição aberta a ser preenchida.

items.q: "I want to apply for this job." To apply means to…
options: ask for the job and send your CV
items.why: To apply = se candidatar: pedir a vaga e enviar o currículo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em recrutamento. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We need to fill this vacancy soon." To fill a vacancy means to…
options: find a person for the open job
items.why: Fill a vacancy = preencher a vaga: encontrar alguém para o cargo aberto.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the offer." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We shortlisted three candidates for the interview." This means we…
options: chose a small group of the best ones
items.why: Shortlist = fazer uma lista curta: escolher os melhores para a próxima etapa.

items.q: "Two candidates turned down the offer." They…
items.why: Turn down = recusar: dizer não à proposta.

items.q: "Let's move forward with this candidate." This means we…
options: continue to the next step with this person
items.why: Move forward = seguir em frente: avançar para a próxima etapa.
